about: PS5®: Experience features specific to the PlayStation® 5 platform such as DualSense® wireless controller integrations including haptic feedback, controller speaker support and adaptive triggers.
PS5® Pro Enhanced: Enjoy PlayStation Super Spectral Resolution support as well as improved shadow and reflections quality.

Stunning gameplay: The iconic original now looks and plays better than ever with no load times, 4K assets plus remastered textures, lighting, shadows and reflections, HDR, Dolby Atmos, Variable Refresh Rate as well as up to 120 FPS in multiplayer.*
The Original, Remastered: Powered by Unreal Engine, Gears of War: Reloaded is a remaster of the blockbuster first Gears of War, now fully optimized for the latest generation of gaming platforms.
